annotation.bound_parties_text: The non-binding Parliament resolution only calls on the Commission and Member States and makes recommendations; it imposes no obligations on any party.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Instructs its President to forward this resolution to the Council and the Commission.
annotation.dates_quote: European Parliament resolution of 29 October 2015 on safe use of remotely piloted aircraft systems (RPAS)
annotation.robot_provision_quote: European Parliament resolution of 29 October 2015 on safe use of remotely piloted aircraft systems (RPAS), commonly known as unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs)
